rule_description: Validate unique stamp and handle journal status when stamp is not found
Validate unique stamp and handle journal status when stamp already exists and sequence is exhausted
condition: WS-JRN-STATUS is equal to "00" and WS-SEQUENCE is equal to 9999
action: Set RSP-ALERT-CODE to 1006, move "Journal stamp exhausted" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, and exit perform
evidence: when "00" if WS-SEQUENCE = 9999 move 1006 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal stamp exhausted" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE exit perform end-if

rule_description: Validate unique stamp and increment sequence when stamp already exists and sequence is not exhausted
condition: WS-JRN-STATUS is equal to "00" and WS-SEQUENCE is not equal to 9999

rule_description: Handle unexpected journal file errors during stamp uniqueness check
action: Set RSP-ALERT-CODE to 9002, move "Journal file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, and exit perform
evidence: when other move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE exit perform
